messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
A supported Semiconductor VNA comparison requires same-scope evidence for the exact R&S VNA configuration, the exact competitor model/configuration, the Semiconductor application or DUT, identical measurement conditions, and the status of each number as specification, typical, measured, nominal, or non-traceable. [1][39][42][83]
### Required evidence
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current passage support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S VNA model, port count, options, and applicable specifications. | The R&S ZNA series covers ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 with different frequency ranges and 2-port or 4-port base units, so the comparison must identify the exact model and configuration. [3][4] | ZNA model ranges are documented from 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz, with 2-port or 4-port units. [3] |
| R&S specification category for every number used. | R&S distinguishes warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, and the source states that non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz. [1] | Dynamic range includes “> 129 dB specification without options,” “147 dB typical with options,” and “up to 170 dB,” so these labels must not be mixed as equivalent claims. [3][6] |
| R&S measurement conditions for the cited specification. | Product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance, and applicable internal automatic adjustments. [58][62] | Effective system data also depends on +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change ≤ 1 °C, same frequency points, same measurement bandwidth, same sweep time, no calibration interpolation, 10 Hz bandwidth, and 0 dBm nominal source power. [58][79] |
| Exact competitor product family, model, options, calibration accessories, and conditions. | The Keysight ENA and PNA passages do not list concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, or TDR option name. [39][42] | The Keysight ENA and PNA passages state that no performance metrics are provided, so they cannot support accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth comparisons. [39][42] |
| Competitor evidence from official or third-party sources when the source is an R&S battle card. | The Keysight page states that the R&S battle card descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data for verification. [22] | The Keysight page also states that the R&S battle card is not Keysight official material. [23] |
| Direct Semiconductor application evidence tying both sides to the same use case. | The available case source links Bare Board for SoCs to PCB test with probing for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, but it lists offered solution as ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool. [32] | The same Bare Board for SoCs evidence lists Advantest and Meritech but does not provide a competitor VNA comparison. [32][33][36] |
| Direct competitor evidence in the same VNA case. | The LSmtron case lists Products: ZNB40 and Competitor: Keysight ENA, with a total solution including probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner. [31] | The LSmtron case DUT is Board to Board Connector, and the passage does not provide ENA model, frequency range, options, or performance metrics. [31][39] |
| Complete test topology and measurement setup. | The AMD 67 GHz stability claim lacks the full instrument combination, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, and DUT conditions. [26] | The high-speed interconnect case page also lists missing topology, probe, calibration, and de-embedding details for multiple cases. [83] |
| Same DUT, fixture, calibration, de-embedding workflow, frequency range, and metrics. | The TRI, AMD, LSmtron, Bare Board for SoCs, and Samsung cases have limitations such as missing DUT details, frequency, fixture, calibration, probe model, or de-embedding workflow. [19] | Without these details, the passages do not support claims that one VNA solution outperforms another in the Semiconductor use case. [19][33][35][39] |
| Evidence that the comparison is a total solution comparison if probes, mount kits, de-embedding, or partners are part of the claim. | The sales pattern passage states that the win factor in the cited cases is not a single instrument specification but a total solution including probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner. [20] | TeraBit Solutions and AtaiTec passages do not prove which component each partner supplied or the exact support scope. [28][37][38] |
| Date, document version, and release status for both sides. | R&S ZNA specifications are identified as document PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026. [5] | The Keysight PCB test image sources lack content date, year, quarter, document version, full model details, option codes, and specifications. [22][45][46][48] |
### Bottom line
The current passages support listing R&S ZNA specifications and some VNA-related Semiconductor or PCB probing cases, but they do not support a quantified R&S-versus-competitor Semiconductor VNA performance comparison without additional competitor model/specification data and same-condition test evidence. [3][6][19][32][39][42][83]

answer.question: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

passages.text:
ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。

### Short answer
A supported Semiconductor VNA comparison requires same-scope evidence for the exact R&S VNA configuration, the exact competitor model/configuration, the Semiconductor application or DUT, identical measurement conditions, and the status of each number as specification, typical, measured, nominal, or non-traceable. [1][39][42][83]
### Required evidence
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current passage support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S VNA model, port count, options, and applicable specifications. | The R&S ZNA series covers ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 with different frequency ranges and 2-port or 4-port base units, so the comparison must identify the exact model and configuration. [3][4] | ZNA model ranges are documented from 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz, with 2-port or 4-port units. [3] |
| R&S specification category for every number used. | R&S distinguishes warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable values, and the source states that non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz. [1] | Dynamic range includes “> 129 dB specification without options,” “147 dB typical with options,” and “up to 170 dB,” so these labels must not be mixed as equivalent claims. [3][6] |
| R&S measurement conditions for the cited specification. | Product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance, and applicable internal automatic adjustments. [58][62] | Effective system data also depends on +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature change ≤ 1 °C, same frequency points, same measurement bandwidth, same sweep time, no calibration interpolation, 10 Hz bandwidth, and 0 dBm nominal source power. [58][79] |
| Exact competitor product family, model, options, calibration accessories, and conditions. | The Keysight ENA and PNA passages do not list concrete model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, or TDR option name. [39][42] | The Keysight ENA and PNA passages state that no performance metrics are provided, so they cannot support accuracy, dynamic range, or bandwidth comparisons. [39][42] |
| Competitor evidence from official or third-party sources when the source is an R&S battle card. | The Keysight page states that the R&S battle card descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data for verification. [22] | The Keysight page also states that the R&S battle card is not Keysight official material. [23] |
| Direct Semiconductor application evidence tying both sides to the same use case. | The available case source links Bare Board for SoCs to PCB test with probing for impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, but it lists offered solution as ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, and de-embedding tool. [32] | The same Bare Board for SoCs evidence lists Advantest and Meritech but does not provide a competitor VNA comparison. [32][33][36] |
| Direct competitor evidence in the same VNA case. | The LSmtron case lists Products: ZNB40 and Competitor: Keysight ENA, with a total solution including probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner. [31] | The LSmtron case DUT is Board to Board Connector, and the passage does not provide ENA model, frequency range, options, or performance metrics. [31][39] |
| Complete test topology and measurement setup. | The AMD 67 GHz stability claim lacks the full instrument combination, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, and DUT conditions. [26] | The high-speed interconnect case page also lists missing topology, probe, calibration, and de-embedding details for multiple cases. [83] |
| Same DUT, fixture, calibration, de-embedding workflow, frequency range, and metrics. | The TRI, AMD, LSmtron, Bare Board for SoCs, and Samsung cases have limitations such as missing DUT details, frequency, fixture, calibration, probe model, or de-embedding workflow. [19] | Without these details, the passages do not support claims that one VNA solution outperforms another in the Semiconductor use case. [19][33][35][39] |
| Evidence that the comparison is a total solution comparison if probes, mount kits, de-embedding, or partners are part of the claim. | The sales pattern passage states that the win factor in the cited cases is not a single instrument specification but a total solution including probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner. [20] | TeraBit Solutions and AtaiTec passages do not prove which component each partner supplied or the exact support scope. [28][37][38] |
| Date, document version, and release status for both sides. | R&S ZNA specifications are identified as document PD 5215.4652.22, Version 24.00, April 2026. [5] | The Keysight PCB test image sources lack content date, year, quarter, document version, full model details, option codes, and specifications. [22][45][46][48] |
### Bottom line
The current passages support listing R&S ZNA specifications and some VNA-related Semiconductor or PCB probing cases, but they do not support a quantified R&S-versus-competitor Semiconductor VNA performance comparison without additional competitor model/specification data and same-condition test evidence. [3][6][19][32][39][42][83]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 5215.4652.22。
- 文件版本：Version 24.00。
- 發布時間：April 2026。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
